def solve():
    face = Q(2000)
    y = Q("0.075")
    r1 = Q("6.5") / 100
    r2 = r1 + Q(-100) / 10000          # rate from year 2 onward (-100 bp)
    days = Q(330)

    # Year 1: coupon on full face, then 35% installment
    out1 = face
    inst1 = face * Q("0.35")
    cf1 = r1 * out1 + inst1

    # Year 2: coupon on balance outstanding during year 2, then 40% installment
    out2 = out1 - inst1
    inst2 = face * Q("0.40")
    cf2_sched = r2 * out2 + inst2

    # Principal remaining after year-2 installment
    out3 = out2 - inst2

    # Year-3 scheduled payment and its value at end of year 2
    cf3 = r2 * out3 + out3
    pv3_at2 = cf3 / (1 + y)

    # Call iff call price strictly below PV of remaining payment
    call_pay = Q("1.03") * out3
    called = call_pay < pv3_at2
    decision = "call" if called else "no_call"

    # Total cash received at end of year 2 (call payment added only if called)
    cf2_total = cf2_sched + (call_pay if called else Q(0))

    t = days / 360
    def disc(k):
        return (1 + y) ** (k - t)

    price = cf1 / disc(1) + cf2_total / disc(2)
    if not called:
        price += cf3 / disc(3)

    return {
        "final": price,
        "principal_after_year2": out3,
        "pv_year3_at_year2": pv3_at2,
        "call_decision": decision,
        "year2_total_received": cf2_total,
